name: General Oceans ASA
summary: General Oceans ASA develops and manufactures oceanographic sensors, underwater vehicle systems, robotic manipulators, and software in Norway and Internationally. The company operates through two segments: Sensors and Robotics. The Sensors segment is involved in the design, manufacture, integration and sale of acoustic and environmental subsea sensors used for underwater perception, navigation, seabed mapping, and oceanographic measurement. The Robotics segment provides underwater robotic vehicles and manipulators used for unmanned subsea operations, inspection, intervention, and defence applications.
